epics.title: Standalone Responsive Knowledge Base & Fast Search Tool
epics.jtbd: When an educational resident, researcher, or faculty member accesses the CRIE knowledge base on desktop or mobile, I want a fast, thoughtful, self-contained search and document exploration interface without third-party integration friction, so that I can immediately find and inspect clinical, academic, and normative resources in seconds.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Zero discrepancy between server search results and frontend document counts
epics.tocConstraintRef: frontend/src/components/Internal.svelte state handling and live data binding
requirements: R1: Remove hardcoded mock domain records from Internal.svelte and bind catalog views strictly to live backend search responses
R2: Implement four explicit catalog lifecycle states in the UI (empty, loading, error, present), ensuring zero domain records render when backend is halted or returns empty

slices.title: Bind Internal.svelte catalog to live search API with 4-state lifecycle handling
slices.jtbd: When implementing frontend state synchronization for this epic, I want Internal.svelte to query the normative search API and handle empty/loading/error/present states, so that the knowledge base catalog never asserts non-existent documents and reflects true backend state.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the backend search service returns zero results or is stopped, When the user inspects the materials catalogue in Internal.svelte, Then no invented domain records are displayed and the corresponding empty or error state message is rendered.
Given an active backend search request in progress, When the user triggers or changes search filters, Then an accessible loading state indicator is visible until data resolution.
Given successful search results from /api/v1/normative/search, When materials are loaded into Internal.svelte, Then only documents returned by the API are rendered with their exact titles, categories, and matching total hit count.
slices.tocConstraintRef: Internal.svelte client-side state machine and search API integration
slices.sixSigmaMetric: 100% adherence to four data view states with 0 synthetic catalog documents rendered
